kept.summary: Weekly Recap: • Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang resigns after having 3 reported affairs. • Billionaire shareholder Leo KoGuan says he will not invest more money in Nvidia without Jensen Huang. • Elon Musk says it would "be an honor" to hire Jensen Huang. • Elon Musk, CZ, Nvidia employees & shareholders petition to bring back Jensen Huang as CEO with over 150k signatures. • Two Nvidia investors holding over $2 billion in shares call for board to reinstate Jensen Huang as CEO. • Jensen Huang discusses returning as Nvidia CEO. • Crypto market crashes with $5.9 billion in liquidations. • Bitcoin falls to
